title: NASA Neptune satellite sheet: Triton (NI) mass 214.×10^20 kg, radius 1,353.4 km
summary: The Neptune satellite fact sheet lists Triton (NI) at mass 214. × 10^20 kg and radius 1,353.4 km.
body: NASA's Neptune satellite fact sheet lists Triton (NI) with mass 214. × 10^20 kg, radius 1,353.4 km, mean density 2,050 kg/m^3, and visual geometric albedo 0.72. Orbital parameters on the same sheet: Semimajor axis (10^3 km) = 354.76; semimajor axis (Neptune radii) = 14.328; orbital period (days) = 5.876854R; rotation period (days) = S; inclination (degrees) = 157.345; eccentricity = 0.000016. These are the cells printed on the sheet. The sheet does not say, on this row, which cells are a spacecraft measurement and which are an estimate. The sheet says R indicates retrograde motion, and S indicates synchronous rotation, the rotation period equal to the orbital period. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last Updated line: 11 March 2024.
